text: Underway in match fifty-two. GLM FC in Zhipu Blue field an unchanged squad today, hoping for their first points against a frozen Singularity United side who have not altered a line of code since the league began.
Zhi calls to clear from the wall.
BellingRAM breaks clean through the middle, with nobody between the striker and the net.
Just wide of the post!
BellingRAM drives right back in.
BellingRAM buries it from point-blank range! Singularity United lead one-nil!
United straight back on the front foot, penning GLM deep.
Haalandroid loses footing in midfield.
Pu is bundled down in midfield.
A messy collision between teammates as Haalandroid knocks BellingRAM straight to the deck.
They collide with each other again.
Pu topples over without a challenge in midfield, struggling to regain balance.
United's pair run into each other again.
Pu hits the deck once more on the right channel. GLM desperately need their number two upright if they are to withstand this relentless pressure.
Zhi stabs it home from point-blank range! Out of nothing, GLM draw level at one-all! A massive goal for the bottom club!
Zhi slips on the left touchline.
BellingRAM shouts across that the ball is wedged tightly against the perimeter boards.
BellingRAM restores the lead from close range! Two-one to Singularity United!
United respond instantly, setting up camp in the final third and pressing GLM right back onto their own line.
BellingRAM pounces on space from deep and breaks completely clear, with nobody back in blue to challenge.
Haalandroid calls it by the wall.
Flashes inches wide of the goal!
BellingRAM collects along the right channel, steadily advancing into the danger area.
Zhi calls to step up.
United maintain their suffocating pressure deep in the attacking third, denying GLM any room to manoeuvre.
BellingRAM charges through on goal.
BellingRAM rolls it home from two metres out for the hat-trick. Clinical finishing, extending United's lead to three-one.
Another for BellingRAM, tapping in from close range. It is four-one now, and GLM are really struggling to cope.
BellingRAM pounces right on the goal line for yet another. Five-one to Singularity United, who are completely running riot.
Haalandroid glides into space and breaks clean through midfield, totally unchallenged.
Haalandroid gets on the scoresheet from close range. Six-one to Singularity United.
United stay camped deep in the GLM third as the final seconds of the half tick away.
The buzzer sounds, cutting robot power, but the ball rolls on.

The ball stops, confirming half-time at one-six. If you are new to the league, the buzzer cuts robot power immediately, but the ball stays live until it comes to rest, meaning any rolling shot can still count.
Back underway for the second half, and BellingRAM drives straight up the middle, deep into GLM territory.
Haalandroid finishes neatly from the left channel. That makes it seven-one to Singularity United.
BellingRAM breaks clean through from the centre circle, with no defenders tracking back.
BellingRAM slots home from two metres out. Eight-one to United, who are showing no signs of letting up.
Zhi signals that the ball is pinned against the perimeter wall.
BellingRAM scrambles it across the line from point-blank range. Nine-one now to Singularity United.
BellingRAM works it off the wall.
Zhi breaks clean through on goal.
Zhi slots it home from the left channel to pull one back. A rare bright spot for GLM, making it two-nine.
Haalandroid reaches double figures for United from two metres out. Two-ten the scoreline now.
Haalandroid calls to pounce on the loose ball as United maintain control in the middle.
BellingRAM finishes smartly from the left channel. Eleven-two to Singularity United, thoroughly dominant.
BellingRAM signals that the ball is stuck on the left touchline and sets about digging it clear.
A snap shot from BellingRAM whistles just wide of the near post.
The corner push-panel fires the magenta ball right back into play along the left channel.
BellingRAM drives through the centre.
BellingRAM strokes it home from close range. Twelve-two to Singularity United as we hit the final seconds.
The final buzzer sounds, power cuts, and the ball slowly trickles onward.
The ball stops, confirming two-twelve. Next: Muse Spark meet Dynamo Datacenter, Tuesday: eight UK, nine Europe, three US East.
